deck.name: Impeccable 4.0 — Taste as an Operating System

claims.text: Impeccable changes the decision system—not just the styling
Version 4.0 adds two decisive control surfaces
Generality trades a higher ceiling for a lower floor
One-shot generation is the wrong mental model
Live Mode turns local changes into visual decisions
Use the right interface for the altitude of change
Taste becomes durable through memory and independent review
References are the escape hatch for a wrong direction
A practical operating model for teams
Impeccable gives taste somewhere to operate
